About

I'm a Machine Learning Engineer and Consultant. Currently, I'm working on a project to help a large Swedish Mining and Drilling equipment manufacturer build RAG applications.

In the past, I have worked in EdTech with companies like Coursera and Udacity, helping build learning experiences that reach millions of students worldwide.

What I Do

I work across the full stack of machine learning projects—from data engineering and model development to deployment and productionization. I'm particularly interested in:

  • Building RAG and LLM-powered applications
  • Machine learning system design and MLOps
  • Educational technology and learning sciences
  • Product thinking and engineering

About This Site

This blog is a collection of my thoughts on Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Product Management, and life in general. I believe in learning in public and sharing what I discover along the way.
